name: QuickPress AI
author: QuickPress AI

sections.description:
Streamline Content Creation with an Unrestricted AI Writing Assistant

QuickPress AI is an uncensored AI content generator for WordPress that works directly inside the WordPress editor, eliminating the need to switch tabs or tools. Whether you need captivating blog posts, bold video descriptions, or on-brand SEO content, this plugin lets you generate and refine uncensored AI content effortlessly.

Automate & Liberate Your Content Creation

Perfect for:
✔ Small business owners creating high-quality optimized and on-brand content
✔ Bloggers crafting compelling narratives for their audiences
✔ Content creators generating fresh ideas and optimized posts
✔ Anyone looking for an uncensored AI writing assistant to speed up their writing process

Features

  • In-Editor Integration: Generate and refine content directly in the content editor.
  • Unrestricted Creativity: Explore ideas without limitations or restrictions on topics or language.
  • Customizable Templates: Use saved templates for titles, content, and excerpts to save time and stay consistent.
  • Fine-Tuned AI Customization: Configure your AI writing assistant to generate content that aligns perfectly with your goals.
  • Streamlined Workflow: Focus on writing powerfully, not switching between tools.
  • SEO Compatibility: Use QuickPress AI with your favorite content analysis plugins for even better results.

Important

A Venice AI “Pro” account is required for API access.

Detailed Installation & FAQs

External Services

This plugin connects to an API to generate AI content on your WordPress website.

It sends your AI prompts to the service for generating page/post titles, content, and excerpts when you click the “Submit” buttons in the QuickPress AI panel in the WordPress content editor.

This service is provided by Venice AI and requires a “Pro” account: Terms of Use, Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Download the QuickPress AI plugin zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin at the top of the page.
  5. Choose the plugin zip file you downloaded and click Install Now.
  6. After installation, click Activate Plugin.
  7. Go to Settings → QuickPress AI in your WordPress admin dashboard to configure the plugin.
